original_test_intent: Measure each GPU memory controller's busy percentage during a declared condition and evaluate the samples against the approved behavior.
original_method: Inventory UUID/BDF and driver/tool, declare active workload/process state, run the exact utilization.memory CSV query at the approved cadence/window, preserve timestamped values/N/A/errors for all devices, and apply the supplied per-GPU statistic without changing workload or GPU settings.
manual_activity: Performance owner defines workload, sample window and memory-controller utilization rule; collection and calculation are automated.
safety_requirements: Do not launch/stop workload or alter clocks/power
Do not confuse percentage activity with memory allocation
agent_execution_scope: Collect exact property on approved schedule
engineer_actions: Approve operating condition and expected policy

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: The property query is correct but one context-free sample and insecure transport are insufficient.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Collect timestamped utilization.memory values by UUID with the declared workload/process state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The literal property and all-visible-GPU scope are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Evaluate a per-UUID time series of memory-controller utilization under the named condition.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds temporal/workload identity and an explicit statistic.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Avoids substituting allocated MiB or judging a transient percentage.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Controller activity is sampling-interval dependent and may not track allocated memory volume.

project_override_considerations: Project policy selects idle/load condition and treatment of transient DMA or background clients.

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Item, command and criterion consistently target memory-controller utilization; the acceptance policy is merely unspecified.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Read-only collection remains feasible; policy inputs only gate verdict.

review_improvement: Keeps memory activity distinct from memory allocation and makes dynamic readings reproducible in context.
independent_technical_reasoning: utilization.memory is the fraction of a recent interval during which GPU memory was active, whereas memory.used is an allocation size. Conflating them would erase the source's intended behavior check; timestamped samples under a named workload preserve it.
